_doc: Gaon Guard AI - Task Execution Plan - All 9 tasks in sequence

tasks.name: A1 Intake
tasks.description: Parse raw complaint (Urdu/Roman Urdu/English) into structured crisis signals
tasks.output: Structured JSON: location, crisis_type[], affected_group, duration_hours, missing_person_signal

tasks.name: A2 Evidence Check
tasks.description: Cross-check A1 output against 5 data sources (weather, roads, health, village, missing persons)
tasks.output: Evidence checks with SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS/NEUTRAL verdicts + confidence level

tasks.name: X Conflict Check
tasks.description: Check if any A2 evidence_check has verdict CONTRADICTS. If yes, trigger TASK_3a.

tasks.name: X Arbitration
tasks.description: Resolve contradictions. Decide PROCEED / HOLD / REQUEST_VERIFICATION
tasks.output: Arbitration decision with reasoning, timeout, verification message
tasks.on_REQUEST_VERIFICATION: Send SMS, wait timeout, then fallback to TASK_4 or HOLD

tasks.name: A3 Severity Scoring
tasks.description: Apply weighted severity scoring, produce dispatch authorization
tasks.input: A1 signals + A2 evidence (+ X arbitration if applicable)

tasks.name: A4 Dispatch
tasks.description: Assign nearest available teams per department, create dispatch tickets
tasks.output: Dispatch tickets with ETA, escalation schedule

tasks.name: B1-B3 Missing Person Scan
tasks.description: B1 scans complaint for missing person signal. If detected, B2 cross-matches against camp registrations. B3 checks for geographic clusters.
tasks.input: Original complaint text + missing persons DB + camp registrations
tasks.output: Match results with scores, family alerts, cluster alerts
tasks.note: Runs in parallel with TASK_5 (dispatch). B1 triggers on EVERY complaint regardless of crisis type.

tasks.name: C1-C3 Aid Audit
tasks.description: C1 audits individual distributions. C2 monitors market prices. C3 detects fraud patterns.
tasks.input: Aid distribution logs + market prices + beneficiary registry
tasks.output: Audit verdicts, price gouging alerts, fraud pattern analysis
tasks.note: Runs after dispatch is created but in parallel with field operations

tasks.name: A4 Tracking
tasks.description: Monitor dispatch lifecycle: check for ACCEPTED at T+30, movement at T+60, escalate if needed
tasks.runs_until: All tickets reach CONFIRMED or ESCALATED

tasks.name: A4 Outcome
tasks.description: Compile final outcome report: which teams arrived, evidence uploaded, confirmations received

execution_diagram: TASK_1 (A1) -----> TASK_2 (A2) ---> TASK_3 (conflict?) ---> TASK_4 (A3) ---> TASK_5 (A4 Dispatch)
